Section D: Media

text: Surveillance is one way society tries to control acts of crime and deviance. Sociologists offer many
explanations for why crime is committed, such as status frustration, Marxist theory and functionalist
theory. However, these views do not explain why some sociologists argue that females commit
less crime or how the actions of the police can lead to deviancy amplification.
